The next administration must be anti-empire to reclaim our sovereignty and for economic justice.

This begins with no aid to Israel.

America will no longer underwrite permanent domination anywhere.

Just as we should not have overthrown Mossadegh, Árbenz, or Lumumba, we should not bankroll the indefinite denial of Palestinian self-determination.

This means an America that respects sovereignty and does not threaten to seize Greenland, strangle Cuba, or invade another country in the Middle East.

Sixty-one years ago, the Voting Rights Act became law after generations of ceaseless work from Black community leaders and activists. Today, the modern Dred Scott Court and Republicans are eviscerating them.

We must honor the legacy of those who put their lives on the line for civil rights by continuing the fight.

This means expanding the Supreme Court from 9 to 13 and terms limits for justices. It means building an economy that gives Black families the opportunity to build generational wealth
